about: His report (2026-10-20): rapid Back / Next ghosts covers and flickers a cover as another one. The Metal draft's zoetrope with the peek on the running dev app, in Max: Next, Back, Next, Back about 250 ms apart (it ends on the starting song), frames kept from the first press; music paused again at the end if a press started it. The size is set for the shot and put back.
pass: The end probe: one cover layer, both side covers filled, the starting song, not playing. Read the strip by time for doubled or wrong covers.

steps.probe: (() => { const m = window.MusicKit && MusicKit.getInstance(); if (m && m.isPlaying) m.pause(); return JSON.stringify({title: document.querySelector('.np__title')?.textContent, playing: !!(m && m.isPlaying), layers: document.querySelectorAll('.np__art .vinyl').length, peeks: [...document.querySelectorAll('.metal-peek')].map(p => p.dataset.side + ':' + (p.dataset.src || '').slice(-24))}); })()
steps.name: end
